title: AI Music Generation, From Prompt to Production: Phlo Young
talk_summary: A workshop on AI music generation tools (Suno, Udio, RVC, Stable Audio) covering voice conversion, text-to-music, and prompting techniques for hobbyist musicians.

takeaways.technique: Pre-generate structured input with an LLM before calling the generative model
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of giving the music model a vague topic and hoping it writes good lyrics, they run a GPT prompt template that produces structured lyrics first, then feed those into the music model.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it allows for better music generation when you uh come in with the lyrics as opposed to giving it a general topic and hoping it comes up with good lyrics itself

takeaways.technique: Reverse-engineer model conditioning from public labels
takeaways.what_they_do: They noticed the music models were trained on RateYourMusic labels, so they look up an artist/genre on RYM and paste those exact labels back into the prompt to steer output.
takeaways.evidence_quote: these models were trained on labels from rate your music so you can almost reverse engineer exactly what sound you want
